equipment_type: Water-to-water heat pump / reversible chiller controller
applies_to: WaterFurnace dual-compressor reversible chiller (water-to-water) heat pumps with the FX10 controller.
summary: BACnet objects for WaterFurnace's dual-compressor reversible chiller water-to-water heat pumps running the FX10 DDC controller. The BAS reads load/source water and refrigerant temperatures, flow switches, compressor and alarm states, and stages the machine by writing Y1/Y2 compressor calls and the reversing valve (O) command. Two flash-backed values set the low-temperature limit adjustment and the compressor on-delay.
notes: Output-type points are volatile and fall back to uncommanded after a power cycle; unlimited writes.
Value-type points (AV/MV) are stored in flash (about 2,000,000 write life); never write them from automatic reset logic.
Multistate numbers assume the BAS shows 255 as uncommanded; if yours shows 254, every state number is one lower (0=Off, 1=On).
No engineering units are printed in the source; temperatures are presumably degrees F.
With lead/lag enabled (factory default) a Y1 or Y2 call starts whichever compressor has been off longest; with it disabled Y1 starts compressor 1 and Y2 compressor 2.
AI9-AI11 report on/off states as analog inputs using 1=Off, 2=On.

integration.summary: The BAS stages this machine directly: MO1/MO2 are the Y1/Y2 compressor calls and MO3 is the reversing valve (O) call. Read load and source water temperatures, flow switches and the alarm code to supervise it. The two configuration values (freeze setpoint adjust, compressor on-delay) are flash-backed and should be set once.
integration.enable: The sheet has no separate enable or occupancy point. The BAS controls the unit with the MO1/MO2 compressor calls and the MO3 reversing-valve call.
gotchas: AV/MV points are stored in flash (about 2,000,000 writes); write them only manually or by schedule, never from automatic reset logic.
Output points (AO/MO) are volatile and go back to uncommanded after a power cycle, so rewrite them after power is restored.
If the BAS shows 254 as uncommanded instead of 255, every multistate value is one lower (0=Off, 1=On).
With lead/lag enabled (factory default), a Y1 or Y2 call starts whichever compressor has been off longest.
AV1 Frz Setpt Adj only takes effect after the control board jumpers are removed.
